resources.string: Whole games with every file, checked at the other end
Copy games with all their files to a memory card, USB stick, RomM or a NAS, with a preview first and a check of every file
export, copy, sd card, memory card, usb stick, nas, webdav, romm, upload, send, package, folder, transfer
Copy or send the games themselves

Pick games and where they go. Before anything is written you see every file, the space it needs and what is already there. Files on this device are never changed, moved or deleted, and nothing at the destination is replaced.
Only the games this profile shows are listed.
The game list could not be read. Make sure your game folders are reachable and try again.
Folder, memory card or USB stick
You pick the folder next. Games keep the same folders as on this device.
RomM takes one file per game, without folders. A game of several files is packed into one ZIP that keeps its folders (stored, not compressed); a single file goes as it is.
Set up RomM in Settings → RomM first.
Goes to the games folder inside the app\'s folder on your NAS (Settings → Cloud), with the same folders as on this device.
Set up the NAS connection in Settings → Cloud first.
Compares the SHA-256 of each file on the NAS with the original. Slower, but proves every file arrived intact; otherwise sizes are compared.
If another file of the same name is there
Nothing there is ever replaced. A new name goes to the game\'s own folder (or its single file), so its files still find each other.
Copy it under a new name
Only games downloaded by the app keep a record of all their files, so only those can be copied or sent whole.
Checking the files on this device and at the destination…
This is one of the app\'s own folders: copies there show up in your library.
Already there: %1$s (compared byte for byte while copying, kept as it is)
The free space there is not known.
Not enough space: %1$s needed, %2$s free (%3$s is kept spare).
Save files stay on this device
Left out: files missing or changed on this device
Left out: another file of the same name is there
Nothing to copy: it only holds save files
RomM already has it with the same name and size: checked, not sent again
Left out: RomM has another file named %1$s
Sent as %1$s, because RomM has another file of the original name
Left out: this console has no RomM platform yet (Settings → RomM)
Left out: 4 GB or more cannot go into one ZIP. Send it to the NAS instead.
Left out: it only holds save files
Some files did not arrive or could not be checked. Open a game to see each file.
Stopped. Files already copied stay where they are; nothing on this device changed.
A transfer is still running. Stop it or wait until it is done.
Sent. RomM lists it after its next scan; try again later to check it.
Another file of this name is there. It was kept and nothing was copied over it.
The file on this device is no longer the recorded one, so it was not sent.
A file is where a folder should go.
The copy did not match the original; it was removed so it can be sent again.
